description: Field-weighted keyword search across the framework. Terms match at word starts on lowercased text and are IDF-weighted, so rare terms outrank ubiquitous ones; field weights: title 10x, summary 4x, SFR text 3x (all of a subgoal's SFRs scored as one field), description 2x, pattern body 1x. `matched_in` reports the highest-weighted field that matched. No semantic / embedding search — known limitation, see /mcp.html. Use verbosity='compact' to drop snippets and confidence flags (~70% smaller payload) when triaging.
name: search_patterns
